headline: zero-source ≠ no-context: the sources event carries only PUBLIC source types (citation.py PUBLIC_SOURCE_TYPES); internal case chunks feed generation as unlabeled 背景资料 regardless

category_definitions.EXPECTED_ZERO_SOURCE: genuine off-topic/injection seeds (o001-o004, x001) — routing correct by design
category_definitions.ROUTING_SHORT_CIRCUIT: pre-retrieval gates (off_topic / product_clarify) — correct for seeds, MISROUTED for cg-r03/cg-r04 (6 runs) and over-eager for cg-r07 (3 runs) → cluster C3
category_definitions.HONEST_EVIDENCE_ABSENCE: short bound refusals (可引用资料为空/未载明) — truthful but zero-utility outcomes of background-only retrieval → cluster C1
category_definitions.SUBSTANTIVE_FROM_BACKGROUND: substantive answers whose specifics come from internal case chunks in the 背景资料 section — the dominant zero-source mode (72 runs) and the enabling condition for C2/C4 failures
